title.zh: 细胞 · 生命的最小单位间

desc.zh: 把一片叶子放大到单个细胞：膜划出边界，核是总控，线粒体供能，叶绿体造糖。点一点每个工位是干什么的，再把动物细胞和植物细胞并排，找齐三处不同。
desc.en: Zoom into a single cell: the membrane draws the boundary, the nucleus runs the place, mitochondria supply energy, chloroplasts make sugar. Tap each workstation to see its job, then put animal and plant cells side by side and find all three differences.

legacyLayout._note: Whitespace and markup of the hand-written lesson this page was converted from, so the conversion could be checked byte for byte (specs/site-template.md §3c).
